name: find_longest_match
source:
import difflib
class Item:
    def __hash__(self): return 1
    def __eq__(self, other):
        with open('value.txt') as f: return f.read(1) == '1'
s=difflib.SequenceMatcher(lambda x: True, [Item()], [Item()])
print(s.find_longest_match())
